parsed_json.up: Select all activity rows for JAK2 with IC50 values in nM. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary, then docs via assays.doc_id. Join compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno for canonical_smiles. Join compound_records on activities.record_id for compound_key. Filter by target_dictionary.pref_name = 'JAK2' and activities.standard_type = 'IC50' and activities.standard_units = 'nM'. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi (coalesce docs.doi and docs.pubmed_id preferring DOI), assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
